# onetsolutions_instance_sizes (Data Source)

Lists the instance sizes on sale, optionally filtered, smallest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every size with at least 4 vCPUs and 8 GB of memory.
data "onetsolutions_instance_sizes" "medium" {
  min_vcpu   = 4
  min_ram_mb = 8192
}

output "medium_size_slugs" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_instance_sizes.medium.sizes[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cpu_model` (String) Only sizes of this CPU model, such as `epyc-9554` (case-insensitive).
- `min_ram_mb` (Number) Only sizes with at least this much memory, in MB.
- `min_vcpu` (Number) Only sizes with at least this many virtual CPUs.

### Read-Only

- `sizes` (Attributes List) The matching sizes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `addons` (Attributes List) The add-ons that can be ordered with the size, for the instance's `addon_ids`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes--addons))
- `bandwidth_mbps` (Number) The network bandwidth, in Mbit/s.
- `cpu_model` (String) The CPU model of the size, such as `epyc-9554`.
- `description` (String) The description of the size (Markdown).
- `id` (String) The UUID of the size.
- `name` (String) The display name of the size.
- `pricing` (Attributes List) The price of the size for each billing cycle it is sold with, excluding VAT. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes--pricing))
- `ram_mb` (Number) The memory, in MB.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the size.
- `vcpu` (Number) The number of virtual CPUs.
- `volumes` (Attributes List) The volume configurations the size can be installed on; the instance's `volume_id` takes one of their `id`s. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--sizes--addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes.addons`

Read-Only:

- `billing_type` (String) How the add-on is billed, such as `recurring`.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the add-on.
- `is_included` (Boolean) Whether the size includes it at no cost.
- `name` (String) The name of the add-on.
- `slug` (String) The slug of the add-on.


<a id="nestedatt--sizes--pricing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes.pricing`

Read-Only:

- `billing_cycle` (String) The billing cycle, such as `monthly`.
- `discount_percent` (String) The discount of the cycle, in percent.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is the size's default cycle.
- `price` (String) The price per cycle, in EUR, as a decimal string.


<a id="nestedatt--sizes--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes.volumes`

Read-Only:

- `disk_gb` (Number) The disk size, in GB.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the volume configuration.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether it is used when no `volume_id` is given.
- `volume_type` (String) The disk type, such as `nvme` or `ssd`.
